test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Vani starts from point A and drives 6 km towards West. She then takes a left turn, drives 8 km. She then turns left and drives 6 km to reach point B. In which direction is point B with respect to point A?
solution:
Given:

Vani starts from point A and drives 6 km towards West.

She then takes a left turn, drives 8 km.

She then turns left and drives 6 km to reach point B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a40786b8da27f65dd4cb83796fb31824a37cfae96b8b2100a45161264766fa30.png] 

Thus, Point B is to the south of Point A.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
